verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly pixel-identical, with only tiny shifts in the decorative dots. Both have the same problems. The 'Biggest Plants' headline reads well, but the original's two large photos are reduced to a small cooling-tower thumbnail and a tiny, unreadable industrial-plant fragment, so the key imagery is lost. Elsewhere the decorative dots are scattered aimlessly, the rule line runs into the photo edge, a stray black bar sits clipped at the top left, and a large empty area is left on the right.
